parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description: The URL of the image to which you want to apply the style transfer. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is in a region other than Shanghai, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

parameters.name: StyleUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the reference image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is in a region other than Shanghai, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
